title: 奎桑提·彩珠手绳
description: 魁梧的奎桑提穿完整纳祖芒服装，在桌前穿彩珠手绳，两柄巨大恩陀佛静立一旁。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: K'Sante is a very broad dark-skinned adult warrior with short textured hair, a strong beard, gold ear ornaments, and proud Nazumah-inspired patterns. Preserve his powerful silhouette through a fully covering patterned tunic, layered armor, opaque trousers, and boots. His two enormous blunt ntofo weapons stand securely in paired floor supports, recognizable as heavy broad geometric forms rather than swords.
art_direction.scene: He sits at a low worktable and threads a few large colorful beads onto a short bracelet cord, concentrating with a warm small smile. A simple cloth pouch and one cup sit beside the beads. The huge ntofos stay still behind the chair, while a pale archway and a single plant make the room welcoming.
art_direction.palette: warm brown, turquoise, coral, muted gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
